notes.title: Hotfix: QoL Updates, HUD Improvements & More
notes.content:
Hey Smallfolk,

Today’s hotfix adds a number of requested quality-of-life features, HUD updates, and system improvements across the game, alongside bug fixes and balance tweaks.
Hotfix Notes
HUD & Interface

Added mana cost and ammo count display on HUD.

Added follow state and aggression indicators for party on HUD.

Character screen now shows an indicator for unspent attribute points.

Gameplay & Systems

Added game settings templates/difficulties.

Party member follow state now also toggleable from the Companions menu.

Holding interact/loot now also extracts resources from nodes.

Melee attacks now take player pitch into account.

Harvesting tools now deal an additional random damage.

Mana potions now describe the amount of mana restored.

Increased overall building structural support by 20%.

Added construction plane lock option for easier placement of building parts.

Added a global notification when a player tries to sleep.

Ladybugs now drop Chitin.

Wood stable now requires wood instead of bark.

Animation & AI

Revised gliding and grappling animations.

Added slight delay to out-of-stamina gliding behavior.

Improved flying AI behavior in Incubator events.

Reworked creature audio vocalizations to repeat less often.

Fixes & Stability

Fixed honey crumble nodes in the Oak Forest.

Fixed audio issue in caverns on PS5.

Fixed issue with transparent surfaces appearing abnormally bright.

Fixed issue where locally hosted servers would not be name-searchable.

When spawning in a tree encampment (start or respawn), party members now spawn on the platform and remain until called.

Thanks for all the continued feedback and reports — it helps us polish every corner of Smalland!

notes.title: Descend Into the Depths – The Underlands Update is Here!
notes.content:
Smallfolk, it’s time to dig deep. 

The world of Smalland just got a whole lot bigger—and more dangerous. Our latest update introduces The Underlands, an underground world filled with new wonders waiting to be uncovered. 


[previewyoutube="_aLYBODJu4o;full"][/previewyoutube]🔦 Explore a World Beneath the Surface 
Embark on a subterranean journey in a unique cavernous area spanning the forest, swamp, and desert, expanding the world map with new points of interest, quests, and base-building opportunities. These winding passageways hide secrets for only the bravest explorers to find. 
🪲 Face Creatures of the Underlands 
But danger lurks in the dark. New enemies make the underground their home. Stay alert as you fight for survival.  
🔮  Unearth Crystals and Harness their Power 
As you delve deeper, keep an eye out for shimmering crystals. These powerful resources can be used to unlock new equipment and abilities that will reshape how you survive in Smalland. 

Download the update now and start exploring the depths! 
Full Patch Notes 
New area: the Underlands,

New resources,

New consumables,

New bossfights,

New quests,

New crafting table,

New stat: the Wyrd,

New ranged weapon,

New armour set variants,

New creatures and creature variants (crystallized),

New building structures,

"Hooks" as ammunition are not needed anymore,

Each shot consumes durability on the "Grappling Gun", until durability is depleted, any number of Hooks may be shot.

Minor bug fixes,

notes.title: Customization and Combat Update Now Available
notes.content:
The latest update for Smalland: Survive the Wilds is here, bringing major improvements to how you build, battle, and soar across the Overlands! 


[previewyoutube="HlPVSFgTR3I;full"][/previewyoutube]🎨 New Customization Options 
A not-so-small part of Smalland is giving players the tools they need to express themselves in their buildings and encampments. This update delivers a number of new ways to bring your world to life and show off your Smallfolk’s style. 

Paint Brush Tool: Express yourself! Use the brand-new Paint Brush to add personality to your structures.

Windows: Add character and light to your builds with a brand-new window building part. 

New Armor Stand interactable has been added

We’ve rebalanced and reimagined creature encounters: 

New attack types added to various creatures 

Health and damage values tuned for better pacing 

Creatures now better respond to perfect blocks, with tighter timing and improved telegraphs for fairer fights 

Light attacks can be cancelled by blocking or dodging

Tuned bows and guns
🪽 Wings Rework

All wings have had their maneuverability refined

Added vibration scale setting for controller

Fixed an issue where friends' servers couldn't be found 

improved feedback when blocking/unblocking players

Whether you're perfecting your base, testing your mettle against tougher foes, or soaring through the canopy with new flair, this update brings a little something for every adventurer.

notes.title: Smalland Update: Guilds, Stables, Vertical Expansion & More!
notes.content:
Greetings Smallfolk! 

We’ve got a major patch going live today that brings a ton of exciting new features and improvements to Smalland: Survive the Wilds. Whether you’re building your dream encampment, exploring the furthest reaches of the Overlands, or bonding with your trusty companion, this update has something for everyone. 

Here’s what’s new: 

🛡️ Guilds Are Here! 

You can now form guilds with other players and take your co-op experience to the next level. Guilds are server-centric, saved with the game world.  

 Introducing server-wide player guilds and shared encampments. 
 Members can share a Tree Encampment that stays active on the server as long as one guildmate is online. 
 Encampment interaction—building, customizing, and reviving—is based on your role. 
 A brand new revive consumable lets guild members bring each other back mid-adventure! 

🐾 Stables & Companion Summoning 
Companions just got a big upgrade! 

 Companions can now be housed in three different types of stables, depending on their size. 
 When at your encampment, you can summon companions for free—or use a Summoning Pebble to bring them into the Overlands. 
 Left a companion behind? No worries—the new Homecoming Totem lets you call them back to your encampment. 

🌲 New Northern Encampments & a New Creature 
Venture north and you’ll find: 

 Two new Tree Encampments that connect to the existing network. Talk to Bonniedel to find and activate them. 
 A brand new task featuring the mysterious Roufus-Bellied Tit—a never-before-seen creature in Smalland.  

🛠️ Quality of Life, Visuals & More 

 Extended companion commands for better control and utility. 
 Decorative mushrooms for all your cottagecore roofing needs. 
 Fixed journal entries for Bonniedel and Granger 
 Improved rock materials and world visuals. 
 Added an in-game "Give Feedback" option—help shape the future of Smalland! 
 Fixed missing toy soldiers from the beach. 
 Added Rufous Mask Helmet 
 To prevent griefing, it’s prohibited to release Companions in another player’s Tree Encampment 
 Ranged weapon rebalancing 
 Added social menu 
 Fixed an issue where >100 creature level would revert when loading the game 
 Plus, a wide range of bug fixes and polish. 

As always, thank you for surviving the wilds with us. Your feedback continues to shape each update—so don’t hesitate to try out the new in-game feedback tool and let us know what you think! 
 
 — The Smalland Team

notes.title: Smalland: Survive the Beta!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In order to improve our game as much as possible, we've decided to make a major update to Smalland's balancing world. 

And to achieve the best possible changes, we'd like to get you involved and hear your feedback! That's why we're officially announcing the immediate availability of the beta test branch on Steam! 

How do I get in?

It's very simple:
1) Go to your Steam library
2) Go to the game properties
3) In the “Beta” tab
4) In “Beta test programs"
5) Select ”public_test"
6) Close the window, an update is launched and you're ready to play!

What do you need to do?

• Please start fresh with a new character and focus on testing the early game areas: the Oak Forest and the Stone Shore areas.
• Please fill in the feedback form - as a token of gratitude, we will be happy to add your name/pseudonym in the game credits (link to the survey below).

It's very important for us to give you access to this content before the update becomes generally available. We need as much feedback and advice as possible to ensure that old and new players alike have a pleasant experience when playing the game.

What does this new beta bring? 

Here's a list of the current improvements: 

 Reorganized resources and enemy encounters in Oak forest and Stone shore to improve overall gameplay experience;
 Reworked onboarding path making it more accesible for beginner players;
 Added Quest log;
 Reworked elemental damage system;
Exclusive rewards are available for each participation (more to come).

How can I give feedback? 

After some hours of play, take the time to answer the survey available here, which will only take a few minutes.
Also follow this link to come to our discord: here you can share your thoughts about the beta! 
Or simple comments below this post! 

Thanks and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes #13: The Taming Update
notes.content:
Greetings Smallfolk! 

It's time to show you what features we're giving you and your creatures, all a part of our Taming Update! We've got some highly requested features in here that we've been working on for a while!

[previewyoutube=wTouRQj_pFM;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/4393829368859bd56963951221af34dfc6fed80e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/aa40a0524af97048462503fc8ff91e4db003c79f.gif

Traps are exactly what they sound like - craft-able mechanisms unlocked from the get-go. The baits for these will need to be unlocked at familiar NPCs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/b7c549001b10204ae865bb3ee671b5fb7c13f47a.png

There are four tiers of trap: Basic, Improved, Advanced and Superior. Each higher tier offers an increased chance at being able to capture your soon-to-be pal. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/c77fff2ab80d70a5d698bfbdef7f4d0616d3e480.png

But how does one tame, you ask? It's simple. Place your trap down and creatures will be attracted to the bait within. They will then trigger the trap mechanism, where you will then wait a moment to see if your trap has been successful!

Alternatively, you can aggro a select creature, engaging them in combat, weakening them and then placing the trap for improved capture chance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/56e163f24a743a4709affb05e6ed4e80b885fbc9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/e55d5b09a827e311bf7b13a5d704c759fcd320ba.gif

With this new system, we've expanded the taming pool, so nearly every creature in Smalland: Survive the Wilds are now tamable!

This includes Jumping Spiders, Cockroaches, Stinkbugs and many more, with now 38 tames in total.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/e296752e98a4c3a1b280e7286cc67077054844b5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/997dba0f1649c22d2d325319b5cd597f68eb8da7.gif

We have also expanded your party size, so you can now tame and have more than one creature following you at a time!

There is now a set party budget (total of 100) that you can use to have numerous creatures active at once. Each creature's value will be different based on level and species. 

So you can combine lots of low budget creatures, such as Ants and Ladybugs, or a couple of high budget creatures like Geckos and Scorpions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/d254bf057726af7d28819bbb29b81a2f0c74ace5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/1639a1d04ef561fd60ce3c9c0a2ecc3252404ed2.png

With this update also comes traits! There are over 15 different traits that will generate when you tame your creature. These come in four tiers: Common, Uncommon, Rare and Legendary. These range from being slightly more durable to even having a healing aura.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/4f08e16bab4c52ffdf5aa14d96f0f2dd6c856faf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/3e4a7161a200f02d5d394d89a81c1817dacaadec.gif

Can you pet the bugs? Yes. You can pet the bugs.
This increases bond with your companion, and higher bond means they can take more and deal more damage, through the power of love and friendship of course.

If the bond hits zero, your creature may release themselves out of neglect...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/601f875354bb02cdb659467c8b1df0b7464c8002.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/83c4c90408e9651e99b7f842d7a787ae62cbc69b.gif

Additionally, killed creatures don't die. That makes sense, give me a moment. 
When a tamed creature's health hits zero, they will be incapacitated until someone or something either finishes them off, or until you use a revive incense to bring them back to life, craftable at the work bench.

Remember, if the incapacitated creature takes too much damage, it will die - so make sure to rev your pet before they perish!

This also has a toggle in the world menu, so that incapacitated creatures can't be killed!

Known issues:Mounting for the jumping spider has been temporarily disabled while we work on a fix. 

Also, to celebare Smalland's including in Steam's Survival Craft Festival, we've partnered with the excellent folks at Fireshine and Pugstorm for a Smalland and Core Keeper bundle! This will be live when this post is 2 hours old!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/a21a706b54c25d6899363f8d4b9c95bc994c3e63.png

That's all for now Smallfolk - don't miss out on upcoming teases!

notes.title: Fire Away! Bombs, Handcannons and Anti-Air Turrets!
notes.content:
Lock and load, Smallfolk, steady your hand and flex your trigger finger because you're packing heat now!

Content Update3: The Amber Valleys, comes 16/10

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/3d78c4ecb7ec088d9e8366815b6a83aa87362fb5.gif

Introducing the Handcannon. It's a cannon that fits in your hand. Self-explanatory, right? The Handcannon shoots iron ammo, crafted using firesand, a new resource within the Amber Valleys. 

Don't think it's going to mean an easy win in every fight though. While the Handcannon is powerful, it's also closer to an old fashioned musket in function, and takes time to load and prime for each shot. You'll need to be smart in how you use it to get the best effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/61b88b7802f3f5fff952364b68a5270099927003.gif

Another use for firesand is that you can also bundle it up into a nice little grenade - extra lethal against ladybugs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/f78e42e3ff9efc0c992c1c369c8ee72e75666ba5.gif

And you're going to need every advantage to take down the new Aetherin turrets. The valley is dotted with these defensive outposts, which will blast away at anything which flies within range - including birds and Smallfolk with wings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/dd5c51df504993255d60757b62e76490287bbd4d.gif

If you've only just earned your bird, don't worry too much if it gets shot down. One hit isn't lethal, but will cause health loss. Repeatedly trying to fly through Aetherin airspace will risk losing your feathered friend, so if you want to reclaim these lands, you'll need to approach each turret on foot, and defeat the squad of Aetherin that emerges. Doing so will disable that turret permanently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/3afdf5559b941b269639bcd80e431e2d373bfbd6.gif

To begin crafting with firesand, you'll need to first meet Granger, a dusty old Smallfolk who now lives as a reclusive beetle rancher in the Amber Valleys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/38d6f426cde02aa1ac0ca8ac704209734fda80b3.png

notes.title: Bringing a bit of STING to Smalland!
notes.content:
Life in the Amber Valleys can have a sting in the tail. Literally.

Content Update 3: The Amber Valleys comes 16/10

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/fae6958846dd657362c7cdba135911cb5d761c32.gif

 The Scorpion is the ultimate enforcer, tanky, agile and most importantly - brutal! At your size, you don't even need to worry about being poisoned when you have a stinger that size through your chest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/5c7f346a4732ae737ea64a425c37e7115884ad29.gif

A tamed Scorpion is the perfect mount for the Amber Valleys. Its speed and agility over the rocky, sandy terrain will help you cover the ground distance in order to shut down those Aetherin turrets, and will also prove helpful in facing the other deadly fauna inhabiting the valleys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/295a571cb177a073ec4c8182676451dc50eaef9c.gif

Those rapid snip-snap pincer attacks allow the Scorpion to get the upper claw in combat, and when your foe is where you want them, you can expend a hefty amount of stamina to go for a powerful sting with that powerful tail!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/bba99dba1f6ad762e1cbe8b9ec44f215bc9247c5.gif

Wait, was that a...Tarantula? Yep. The Overland's spider population just got larger and deadlier, with the addition of this monstrous hairy arachnid. Lurking among the rocks and cliffs, these beasts will test even the hardiest Smallfolk warrior, so watch your step when exploring!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/97f1c03d2802e0d967175d3125d1118bb581fba0.gif

Of course, there may still be a few surprises in these sun-baked lands. Find out what else is coiled and waiting in store for you on October 16th, when the Amber Valleys update releases!

notes.title: Prepare to embark into...the Amber Valleys
notes.content:
North of the Forbidden Monuments, where not even the Eagle is foolish enough to patrol, is home to a much more malicious menagerie of chitinous creatures...Smallfolk will need to expand their firepower and gain new wisdom if they wish to survive...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/a0c0ae457d6ec6dcbb8fea3e682ec0d3916e63b0.png

Begin the next stage of the Smallfolk story on 16/10/23

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/0336c292de54f2be55963e9f9743075919468cd7.png

The scorched sands of the Amber Valleys are a marked contrast to the lush greenery you're used to. In corroded caves, across rugged roads, await new threats, fights and frights! So why not take solace at the Oasis, maybe even set up a small outpost and savour your time in the sun, you're a long way away from the Burrows now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/329beeeef12a55c2591a50ac5d305281baac34db.png

But you know who isn't far from home? The Aetherin. Those you encountered among the Forbidden Monuments were mere scouts, the Amber Valleys are much closer to their home... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/1a044361fb98d7c7515c7aa37b420bbd2206abad.png 

One key thing to learn is that the Aetherin of the Valleys defend their airspace with ruthless efficiency. Using explosive firesand they have constructed turrets to shoot down anyone who tries to encroach on their territory by air.

Don't worry - these turrets may knock your beloved bird out of the sky, but they won't kill them. At least, not immediately. You'll want to set out on foot to lure the Aetherin warriors out of the turrets. Defeat them, and the turret will be permanently deactivated, creating a pocket of safe airspace for your high-flying adventures. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/80f314aaad424735827e06972e905d76564b1e9d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/76e5e4173e4a2ea64454b2de7d677c2f85a4b6e5.png

Though, powerful as they are, the Aetherin aren't the dominant threat in this barren land. They worship a new and deadly creature, unique to the Amber Valleys. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/b6dfd6f575c94cbe031b0a0541432636736ed8ba.png

We have more to come tomorrow, with details on the local wildlife, including creatures unlike anything the Smallfolk have battled before!

notes.title: A Closer Look At Levelling Up!
notes.content:
The creatures are getting stronger Vanguard, can you say the same for yourself?

With the new experience and attributes system, you can!

Whenever you kill, harvest, or complete a key story moment, you will be rewarded with experience points.
Different creatures and resources will reward different amounts of experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/40efe03a7c9928e955fbcdba3442bd098e719b8d.gif

In turn, this will give you points that can be spent in four areas; 


 Strength determines how much damage you deal
  Dexterity increases movement speed
 Constitution increases base health
 Endurance increases base stamina


Player characters have a level cap of 100. You will not need to start a new character to take advantage of this. All existing characters will be designated Level 1 when the the Forbidden Monuments update goes live on Thursday. 

More experienced players with more powerful gear and armour will naturally level up faster, so we anticipate all characters will quickly reach the level they would have been at had the levelling system been in place when they were first created.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/3035927cc09d7a890f41f948617ba147eac60175.png

Though these new levels and attributes aren't just for you! You can level up your tamed creatures to level 10 and increase their stats. 

Creatures will spawn in the wild at different levels, so you might even want to search around using antenna mode to find a creature with a desirable baseline of stats before taming so you can get the tankiest or fastest creature you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/093f253b86272cf2fbf75f5d72d3637f9426989e.png

Rest assured, we will be monitoring and refining this system to give you folks a fulfilling and balanced experience.

notes.title: FAQ Friday #15
notes.content:
Hey Smallfolk!

Happy New Year!

We are so excited for 2022 and what we can share with you, so there are exciting things to come, but we'll still be here to answer those burning questions in the meanwhile!

Without further ado...

Q - Will there be bigger areas on the map that are free of trash and leftovers of humans? Many of the little clips we have seen take place in polluted surroundings.

A - Yes, truth be told these are easier to create initially so when you see behind the scenes in some of these shots you have some of the more developed areas, whereas the more organic ones take much more time to create. So they look and feel organic, but still have regular gameplay spaces regarding size, height. Initially in the very early days we did lots of experiments and areas either looked right, or felt right, but rarely both, so it meant a lot of level design rules and revisions. But the short answer is yes, lots of overgrown areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/371f83791b1ac8b918cc94822b66e91fbabcf7aa.jpg

Q - Can I only ride my animal friends, or will they protect me like the game horizon zero?

A - It depends on the creature, some follow and some are mounts when tamed. Mounts have different strengths and weaknesses in different situations. And your allies will sometimes attack when you attack like a loyal steed, or initially retreat but attack if you are attacked, some will attack a creature on the same level of the food chain, while others may run away. Some may also cause trouble and get into fights you might not want to have. We are trying to give the creatures as much personality as possible, but also look and feel like real creatures (which are somewhat expressionless), so this is being portrayed via audio and their behaviour to their surroundings. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/be7f91a5641d21966278b4b8d22906ce8135e005.jpg

Q - Okay. Sooooo I don't mean to be super technical, but watching your short diary #2 on armour, based on the insect faction you choose to work with, you stated that you are will be able to craft that insects armour, assuming that you will be rewarded with parts to craft blueprints or even the armour its self as rewards.  However, my questions would be based on the armour, is it made from the insects themselves?  And if so is that desecrating their dead to get the items to craft the armour?  I know this seems a little dark but I am just trying to see this from an angle of what others might think as well.  I think the armour sets are really good looking and assuming again that the armour you are showing looks to be like some of the highest tiered armour in the game you will be able to craft toward the end game or much much later.  I would love to hear your feedback.

A - Great question, hopefully, we can give some of the insight here as this wasn't a quick decision. 
The quick answer is yes, some of the armour is made from the same insect carapace as the species you are aligned with, which in human terms could be somewhat grim. This isn't the case with all creatures, but as an example, Ant armours certainly do use carapaces. This could, as you mentioned, be perceived a little dark but also is in line with one of the major tones of the game; the circle of life. Creatures who are friendly to you may eat one another as predator and prey. And certain creatures will not care about their allies being killed as they put the overall hive first and foremost.

But although we aim to make everything as relatable and realistic as possible, we also want to make sure it's fun and makes sense for gameplay. So in the case of Ants and wearing the Ant armour as a specific example, you have to work with the Ants and you need to earn their trust over time and when worthy, they will trade and gift you some of the elements you need including parts of their fallen for you to create an armour set, which the Smallfolk see as an honour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/14b49a0465d7164f23a7bff81d352d2871d16f29.jpg

Thanks for the great questions, as always!

We don’t like to share these updates with you, but with community being at the heart of Smalland we wanted to share with you as soon as we made a decision.

Update on Early Access release & the Demo

We have conducted some closed testing sessions recently which have provided so much wonderful feedback. This testing has shown us that there’s more we want to do before we throw open the gates to Smalland. We won't rush anything out.

There’s two pieces of news to share, one is that the demo will not be coming in October, and the other is that the Early Access release is going to move out of 2021. 

We are committed to bringing a demo out for Smalland and we’re excited to give players a taste of what awaits them, but the timeline for this is determined by when we’re confident in what we want to show you rather than placing another date in the calendar to work towards. Rest assured we’ll share more as soon as we can.

Both moves are explained by the same motive, which is that we don’t want to put Smalland out until we’re 100% confident. We’re committed to the community and to delivering the experience that you are looking for in Smalland. This is the first internally developed game from Merge Games, and whilst the decision to move anything is never taken lightly, we know that it’s the right thing to do. 

Moving Forward

There are various levels of testing and QA underway as development continues and we want to thank the community for the support and patience in taking the Smalland journey with us. If you haven’t already, please consider joining the Discord to hear about any future testing opportunities that may arise, you can find the Discord server at https://discord.gg/smalland 

We’ve had an open approach to the development process and always aim to share our progress with you via community posts, dev diary videos and just hanging with the community in Discord. This will continue and we invite you to continue the journey with us until Smalland is everything we want it to be and we’re ready to welcome you into our huge, tiny world.

We can’t wait to do this with you, but we’re 100% committed to doing it right.

Much love,

The Smalland Team.

Hi all!

We have another update for you all today! This covers one of the many creatures of Smalland, whilst giving examples how the diverse creatures can effect gameplay and the world around you!

In the world of Smalland, you're either a potential threat to many species of creatures, a source or food or even prey! One of these many creatures includes the deadly apex predator; the Blue Tit. This winged maelstrom of death can swoop down from the heavens and take its prey with very little warning. Preparation will be key to survival, because only preparation can protect or hide you. Can you to reason with it, could you help it, and maybe even solicit an alliance?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/853d29bda8a70990d2b1fffb0e9c322f9618f2a1.gif


If you can befriend and earn their trust, you will be able to take to the skies and soar above the anthills at war, the arachnid dens, and the hives of warmongering wasps. The prey becomes the predator, able to swoop down and besiege the threats you once had to fearfully run from and able to reach the ripe treasures you could only previously access once they had fallen to the ground. Although this exhilarating freedom also comes with a price, new feathered threats roam the skies, hungry and territorial!

Features

 This is just one of the multiple bird species and sizes
 The Blue Tit has access to certain resources that will be needed for progression
 You can choose to take these resources by force, or ally with the creature 
 It's behaviour is affected by seasons, as well as day and night
 It also has dynamic behaviour based on situational events and surroundings

notes.title: Dive into the diverse seasons of Smalland in our new community update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/3adb1c7fbd9e3e0b2b2f99db9037c3c4580be78e.gif

Hey all!

Thanks so much to the community for the great response to our recent update last month. Everyone across the development team super appreciate all of your comments and it's great to see so many are excited for the game! We're continuing to make some fantastic progress on the development, and excited to give you more insights into the game starting today with Seasons.

To survive in Smalland means to defy nature itself as you brave fierce conditions against all odds. As you explore, the world is ever-changing and dynamic and will effect the way you play. From the warm spring and the beautiful hot Summer, to the cool breeze of the autumn and bitter Winter, you'll have to manage your load outs to adapt to the changing landscape!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31398346/904d1bc8d4dbbc294a9e3fd7265a2459ef7e7687.gif

This cycle sees changes in creatures behaviour, some hiding, some more desperate for food, moving further from the comfort of their territories to risk death at the hands of another rather than succumb to starvation. 

Each Season brings benefits and opportunities which you will need to learn if you are to survive. Exploration is key to take advantage of the cycling resources and effects, but without the right level of preparation, it will be difficult to see the sun dawn on the next day, let alone the next Season!

Stay tuned for more detailed updates from the development team! We'll be discussing lots more features of the game very soon and providing more content for you as we work hard towards release! 

Seasons Features

 The four cycling seasons have a dramatic effect on the game world
 Creatures and resources become more common or hard to find in different areas per season
 Creature behaviour is dynamic and changes per season 
 Certain creatures and resources only appear in certain conditions
 The player will have to prepare and manage their load outs for survival per Season!
 In-game PVE Events are themed around the different seasons
 Each season has its own set of challenges, some things become easier, others harder, but each is 
     balanced so no particular season is harder than the other

notes.title: A quick update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're sorry for the lack of updates lately. But we've got some news for you now.

When we started development of Smalland, we had one developer doing the entire game in something called 'blueprint programming' in Unreal Engine. The problem with this type of programming is that it's incompatible with most PC and multiplayer programs out there. On January 25th, we announced that we were bringing in a few developers. We quickly decided it'd be a good idea to start the game from scratch, this time using C++ programming. C++ is ten times faster than blueprint, and will allow us to deliver the survival experience you all deserve! With this new programming language, the performance will be more efficient, the multiplayer servers will now have over sixty player slots, and additionally, this means that you'll be able to look forward to new exciting features and updates in the coming months.

For the past three months, we've been working on the skeleton of our game. Most of it is non-visual stuff, but we're also working on things like animations, models, and level design! As a sneak peek, here's a look at our working UI model:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31398346/d4078e7b7505ed933d8d4412807d9d7798b98b83.png

We'll have some more exciting stuff for everyone to see next month. We're all working really hard to make SMALLAND a reality, and we appreciate your patience and support. Thank you!
